svg.text: Caraiani–Newton: the roadmaps it needs, in merge order

Bottom row: already merged into TauCetiRoadmap. Wave W1 depends only on main and can merge now; each wave above merges once every wave below it has merged; boxes in one wave are independent and can merge in parallel. A box with several roadmaps is a bundle that goes up together.

Lines show essential dependencies only (transitive reduction): README supplier citations for open pull requests, atlas stage links for the rest. Upward stage links and plan citations are not drawn: they move down. FoundationsAndLibraryIntegration (library bookkeeping) and the five roadmaps needed only through an upward citation (drops.json) are omitted.
current `top` label: being worked on now
draft pull request (latest deep review: changes needed)
ready: latest deep review approves this head
ready: approved at an earlier head, re-review pending
AI review approved this head; awaiting the human approval

dashed chip inside a box: an open pull request that this roadmap cites and that must merge before it — another author's roadmap, or one of ours outside the Caraiani–Newton closure (marked "ours"); chips are listed in their own merge order and "after #n" marks a chip that needs another chip
Badge "PR A/B": the roadmaps sharing a letter go up in one pull request (A = RG II + adelic groups + smooth representations; A′ stacked on A; B = the adic package). Updated 2026-11-13T18:20Z.
